description:
INDUSTRY DAY EVENT, SITE VISIT, AND SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE BATTALION OPERATIONS FACILITY II HUMPHREYS ENGINEER CENTER, ALEXANDRIA, VIRGINIA  

  THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS, QUOTATIONS OR BIDS. THERE WILL NOT BE SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS, OR DRAWINGS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME.   

 The Baltimore District will be hosting an in-person Industry Day Event and Site Visit for the Battalion Operations Facility II (BOFII) Humphreys Engineer Center (W912DR27R1CEH), located at 7701 Telegraph Road, Alexandria, VA 22315. This event is scheduled for 17 December 2026. The event will include a project overview presentation, site visit, followed by a limited number of one-on-one meetings with Prime contractors to be held with the Project Delivery Team. There will be a virtual option for the project overview presentation with information that will be posted closer to the event. There will not be a virtual option for the site visit. You must be present in person for the site visit. 

 This Industry Day Event notice contains a Market Survey in which USACE NAB intends to gather market research regarding the capability of firms who have participated in like requirements utilizing the Construction Management at Risk approach. This Notice does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP); it does not guarantee the future issuance of an RFP; nor does it commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, USACE NAB will not accept unsolicited proposals. 

 This project will be executed as a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 2808a, Facility Construction Repair. This approach will involve the general contractor during the design phase to provide feedback and input to the designer of record and the Government on constructability, operability, cost, and value engineering on the design being developed. 

 No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this request or any follow-up information requests.  All costs associated with responding to this Notice or attending the Industry Day will be solely at the responding party's expense. Responses to this notice will be used by the Government to make appropriate acquisition decisions. 

  Background.   

 The magnitude of construction of this project is between $50,000,000 and $100,000,000. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 236220 - “Commercial and Institutional Building Construction”, which has a small business size standard of $45,000,000. 

  Project Description.  The Battalion Operations Facility II (BOF II) is a planned two-story, approximately 60,000 SF administrative facility situated at the Humphreys Engineer Center in Alexandria, Virginia. The building will accommodate administrative offices, conference rooms, multi-purpose workshops, and critical building systems, including fire detection and suppression, energy management control systems (EMCS), and comprehensive telecommunications infrastructure. The scope also encompasses extensive supporting infrastructure and site development, including utility distribution (electrical, water, gas, sanitary sewer, and IT networks), roadway and site lighting, surface parking, curb and gutter systems, pedestrian sidewalks, stormwater management facilities, and environmental landscaping. 

 The event's primary goal is to seek input from the construction industry and answer questions regarding best practices for project execution.  Due to the limited accommodations, each General Contractor firm is limited to two (2) representatives. If you wish to have one representative for the General Contractor be a key subcontractor that will be allowed as long as you advise the company the subcontractor represents in addition to your firm.
